title: Studless partitions.
officialText:
The minimum thickness of vertically erected studless solid plaster partitions of 3/8-inch (9.5
mm) and 3/4-inch (19.1 mm) rib metal lath or 1/2-inch-thick (12.7 mm) long-length gypsum lath and gypsum board partitions
shall be 2 inches (51 mm).
SECTION BC 2505
SHEAR WALL CONSTRUCTION
